_about: HERD inst_id -> reporting entity. Built 2026-09-23. 'link' = HERD report covers exactly one IPEDS unit; 'piece' = HERD reports a component separately that Carnegie folds into the IPEDS unit (summed); 'combined' = one HERD report covers several IPEDS units that Carnegie designates separately (kept as one entity, never split); 'independent' = research institution with no usable IPEDS/Carnegie record; 'drop' = excluded. Every link/piece/combined row was checked against Carnegie's FY2021-23 R&D.
